National Council will deal with matters affecting employees generally, e.g., minimum remuneration, Dearness Allowance, Pay of common categories. Matters of interest to employees of a single Department will not be dealt with by National Council. ~eetings to be-held at least once in 4 months. Special meeting can be held by the Chairman on his own, or on request of Official/Staff Side. The meetings at periodical intervals are essential as they help in resolving differences between the Government and the Staff
